user.title: MariaDB Export
user.description: Export Home Assistant history from a MariaDB or MySQL recorder database.

recorder.title: Recorder database
recorder.description:
The recorder is using `{database}` on `{host}` as `{username}`.

The password stays in the recorder configuration and is read again for each export. That account can write. A separate read-only user is safer.

manual.title: Connection
manual.description: Use a read-only MariaDB account. Exports run SELECT statements only.

data_description.host: Leave this blank when you connect with a Unix socket.
data_description.ssl: Turn this on when the server requires TLS.

reauth_manual.title: Update password
reauth_manual.description: MariaDB rejected the account. Enter the current password.

reauth_recorder.title: Recorder password
reauth_recorder.description: Update the recorder database password in Home Assistant, then submit to try the connection again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to MariaDB. Check the host, port, and that the server accepts this connection.
error.invalid_auth: MariaDB rejected the username or password.
error.unknown_database: That database does not exist or this user cannot see it.
error.missing_host: Enter a host or a Unix socket.
error.invalid_export_dir: The export folder must stay inside the Home Assistant config directory.
error.invalid_limit: Enter a row limit from 1 to 2000000.
error.invalid_timeout: Enter a timeout from 0 to 86400 seconds.
error.invalid_url: The recorder database URL could not be read.

abort.already_configured: This MariaDB database is already configured.
abort.not_mariadb: The recorder database uses {scheme}, which is not MariaDB or MySQL. Add the integration again and enter a MariaDB connection.
abort.recorder_missing: The recorder is not running, so there is no database URL to use.
abort.invalid_url: The recorder database URL could not be read.

data_description.export_dir: Folder inside the config directory. Export files are written here.
data_description.default_limit: Maximum rows in one export when the action does not set a limit.
data_description.statement_timeout: Seconds before MariaDB stops a query. Use 0 to leave the query uncapped.
